option.name: 恭王府
option.address: 北京市西城区什刹海街道前海西街17号
option.rank: 北京人文古迹景点榜第3名
option.description: 恭王府，国家重点文物保护单位，为清代规模最大的一座王府，曾先后作为和珅、永璘的宅邸，位于北京什刹海的西南角。1851年恭亲王奕訢成为宅子的主人，恭王府的名称也因此得来。恭王府历经历经了大清王朝乾隆、嘉庆、道光、咸丰、同治、光绪、宣统凡七代皇帝的统治，见证了清王朝由鼎盛而衰亡的历史进程，承载了极其丰富的历史文化信息，故有了一座恭王府，半部清代史的说法。清室覆亡后，府邸的产权曾归属辅仁大学，20世纪90年代，恭王府花园对外开放，2008年恭王府完成府邸修缮工程后，全面对外开放。恭王府作为清朝亲王的府邸，其建筑布局规整、工艺精良、楼阁交错，充分体现了皇室辉煌富

option.name: 天坛公园
option.address: 北京市东城区天坛街道天坛东里甲1号
option.rank: 北京人文古迹景点榜第2名
option.description: 天坛公园位于北京市南部，东城区永定门内大街东侧，占地约270万平方米。在整个北京城里，北有地坛祭地，南有天坛祭天，东有日坛祭太阳，西有月坛祭月亮，其中天坛最为光彩夺目、气宇非凡。天坛始建于明永乐十八年(1420年)，清乾隆、光绪时曾重修改建。为明、清两代帝王祭祀皇天、祈五谷丰登之场所。天坛是圜丘、祈谷两坛的总称，有坛墙两重，形成内外坛，坛墙南方北圆，象征天圆地方。主要建筑在内坛，圜丘坛在南、祈谷坛在北，二坛同在一条南北轴线上，中间有墙相隔。圜丘坛内主要建筑有圜丘坛、皇穹宇等等，祈谷坛内主要建筑有祈年殿、皇乾殿、祈年门等。

option.name: 圆明园
option.address: 北京市海淀区清华西路28号
option.description: 圆明园位于北京市西北部郊区，海淀区东部。是一座举世文明的皇家园林。原为清代一座大型皇家御苑，占地约5200亩，平面布局呈倒置的品字形，圆明园由圆明园、长春园、绮春园三园组成，总面积达350公顷。圆明园的陆上建筑面积和故宫一样大，水域面积又等于一个颐和园，总面积等于8.5个紫禁城。圆明园汇集了当时江南若干名园胜景的特点，融中国古代造园艺术之精华，以园中之园的艺术手法，将诗情画意融化于千变万化的景象之中。圆明园的南部为朝廷区，是皇帝处理公务之所。其余地区则分布着40个景区，其中有50多处景点直接模仿外地的名园胜景，如杭州西湖十景，不仅模仿建筑，连名字也照搬过

option.description: 北京故宫，旧称紫禁城，是中国明、清两代24位皇帝的皇宫，现在指位于北京的故宫博物院，位于北京市中心，是无与伦比的古代建筑杰作，也是世界现存最大、最完整的木质结构的古建筑群。故宫宫殿建筑均是木结构、黄琉璃瓦顶、青白石底座，饰以金碧辉煌的彩画。

option.name: 雍和宫
option.address: 北京市东城区北新桥街道雍和宫大街28号(雍和宫地铁站F东南口步行250米)
option.rank: 北京人文古迹景点榜第4名
option.description: 雍和宫(The Lama Temple)位于北京市区东北角，清康熙三十三年（1694年），康熙帝在此建造府邸、赐予四子雍亲王，称雍亲王府。雍正三年（1725年），改王府为行宫，称雍和宫。雍正十三年（1735年），雍正驾崩，曾于此停放灵枢，因此，雍和宫主要殿堂原绿色琉璃瓦改为黄色琉璃瓦。又因乾隆皇帝诞生于此，雍和宫出了两位皇帝，成了“龙潜福地”，所以殿宇为黄瓦红墙，与紫禁城皇宫一样规格。乾隆九年（1744年），雍和宫改为喇嘛庙，特派总理事务王大臣管理本宫事务，无定员。可以说，雍和宫是全国规格最高的一座佛教寺院。

option.name: 午门
option.address: 北京市东城区东华门街道景山前街4号故宫博物院内(南侧)
option.description: 午门是紫禁城南面的城门，也是这座皇城的正门，更是紫禁城四座城门中最大的一座。建于明永乐十八年，已有近600年的历史。午门的平面呈“凹”字形，主城楼东、西两侧向前延伸出的城台上各有两座方亭与中央的主楼形成唿应，形若朱雀展翅，因此午门又被称为“五凤楼”，同时唿应了中国历代王朝宫殿的传统，即南方以朱雀门为皇宫正门。午门城楼共设有5个门通往内城，城楼中间开有三门，城台两侧还分别设有一座掖门。而位于城楼正中的这座门是皇帝出入的“御路门”，除了当朝天子，只有皇后在大婚当天乘坐喜轿入宫时，以及科举最终殿试高中的状元、榜眼和探花出宫时可以走一次，以示皇帝给予的特殊优待。

option.address: 北京市海淀区青龙桥街道新建宫门路19号
option.rank: 北京本地人推荐景点榜第7名
option.description: 颐和园，北京市古代皇家园林，前身为清漪园，坐落在北京西郊，距城区十五公里，占地约二百九十公顷，与圆明园毗邻。它是以昆明湖、万寿山为基址，以杭州西湖为蓝本，汲取江南园林的设计手法而建成的一座大型山水园林，也是保存最完整的一座皇家行宫御苑，被誉为皇家园林博物馆，也是国家重点景点。

option.address: 陕西省西安市新城区解放门街道南大街2号
option.rank: 陕西历史古迹景点榜第3名
option.description: 西安城墙是明太祖朱元璋洪武三年（公元1370年）在隋、唐都皇城的遗存，历经八年扩建而成的，是我国现存规模最大而又保存完整的古代城池建筑，为国家级重点文物保护单位。西安城墙建筑型制宏伟，功能设计周密，矩形城池，墙体全长13.74公里，南、北垣稍长于东、西垣。每隔120米有一座12米x20米的突出部，称“敌台”，全城共98座敌台；每座敌台上建有屯兵敌楼1座。城四隅各建角楼1座。东、西、南、北垣各建有城门1座，各门外均建有护门瓮城，瓮城上建有城楼、箭楼各1座。瓮城外临内侧护城河岸，建有控制“吊桥”的闸楼（亦称谯楼）1座。孔庙（即“碑林”）旁侧城顶建有魁星楼1座

option.name: 小雁塔
option.address: 陕西省西安市碑林区长安路街道友谊西路74号
option.description: 小雁塔位于西安市南门外友谊西路东段南侧的荐福寺内，属全国重点文物保护单位，是一座典型的密檐式佛塔，与大雁塔东西相向，因规模小于大雁塔，故称小雁塔，是唐代古都长安保留至今的两处重要标志之一，“雁塔晨钟”也是清代关中八景之一。 小雁塔虽不及大雁塔规模宏大，但这里环境清幽，风景优美，在古城中别有一番韵味。雁塔是密檐式方形砖构建筑，初建时为十五层，高约46米，塔基边长11米，塔身每层叠涩出檐，南北面各辟一门；塔身从下往上逐层内收，形成秀丽舒畅的外轮廓线；塔的门框用青石砌成，门楣上用线刻法雕刻出供养天人图和蔓草花纹的图案，雕刻极其精美，反映了初唐时期的艺术风格。

tips.text: Unilateral visa-free entry: ordinary-passport holders of the listed countries (incl. Japan and Korea) may enter for up to 30 days for business, tourism, visiting family/friends, exchanges or transit. For most listed countries the policy runs until 2026-12-31. Work, study and reporting still need a visa.

sources.title: 外交部 · 单方面免签政策常见问题解答 / FAQs on Visa-free Entry

tips.text: 240-hour visa-free transit (57 countries, e.g. USA, UK, Japan, Korea): you need an onward ticket with confirmed date/seat to a THIRD country or region, enter at one of 65 designated ports, and stay within designated areas for up to 10 days. A round trip back to your departure country does not count as transit.

sources.title: 国家移民管理局 · 过境免签政策 (NIA)

tips.text: Accommodation registration: hotels register their foreign guests. If you stay somewhere other than a hotel, you or your host must register with the local public security authority within 24 hours of checking in.

sources.title: 国家移民管理局 · 网上办理外国人旅馆以外住宿登记政策解读 (2026-09-21)

tips.text: Arrival card can be filed online in advance (NIA website / "移民局12367" app / WeChat or Alipay mini-program). NIA hotline 12367 (from abroad +86 12367) answers policy questions.

sources.title: 在中国日本国大使館 · 中国渡航に必要な手続

tips.text: Payment (general info): mobile payment is the norm. China's central bank has widened both linking foreign bank cards to Chinese payment apps and using overseas e-wallets in China, and raised the limits. Foreign-card acceptance at major merchants has improved, but not every shop takes cards. Refusing yuan cash is illegal and being rectified; you can exchange money at international airports, bank branches, ATMs and hotels of four stars and up. Before the trip, link your card to Alipay or WeChat Pay by following the apps' own instructions, and keep a card and some cash as backup.

sources.title: 中国政府网 · 便利外籍来华人员、老年人等群体，这些支付场景已优化（新华社 2024-07-27）

tips.text: Before you check in, confirm with the hotel that it accepts foreign guests. Fliggy listings do not say whether a property can register a foreign passport.
Train and many attraction tickets are real-name: book with your passport name/number exactly as printed, and bring the same passport.

narrative.title: Historic Beijing and Xi'an: A Traveler's Guide
narrative.overview: Explore China's rich imperial past across Beijing and Xi'an. Discover grand palaces, ancient temples, and historic city walls spanning the Ming, Qing, and Tang dynasties.

days.headline: Arrival in Beijing and Prince Gong Mansion
days.tip: After checking into your hotel, visit Prince Gong Mansion to explore Qing dynasty history at a relaxed pace.

days.headline: Temples, Palaces, and Imperial Gardens
days.tip: Start early at the Palace Museum, then head south to Temple of Heaven. Save Old Summer Palace for last.

days.headline: Lama Temple, Meridian Gate, and Summer Palace
days.tip: Visit Lama Temple first, then Meridian Gate. End your day exploring the expansive Summer Palace grounds.

days.headline: Train to Xi'an and Ancient Walls
days.tip: After arriving by train and checking in, explore Xi'an City Wall before visiting Daming Palace National Heritage Park.

days.headline: Small Wild Goose Pagoda Before Departure
days.tip: Visit Small Wild Goose Pagoda in the morning for a quiet historical experience before your afternoon flight.

d0-hotel.name: Super 8 Select Hotel Beijing Nanluoguxiang
d0-hotel.blurb: Hotel near Nanluoguxiang subway station in Beijing.

d0-p1544.name: Prince Gong Mansion
d0-p1544.blurb: The largest Qing dynasty mansion, once home to Prince Gong, witnessing centuries of imperial rise and decline.

d1-p1350.name: Temple of Heaven Park
d1-p1350.blurb: A vast Ming and Qing imperial sacrificial complex where emperors prayed for good harvests under grand architecture.

d1-p1345.name: Old Summer Palace
d1-p1345.blurb: Ruins of a magnificent Qing royal garden that once blended traditional Chinese landscaping with replicated scenic sites.

d1-p64.name: Palace Museum
d1-p64.blurb: The Forbidden City, an unparalleled ancient wooden architectural masterpiece serving as the Ming and Qing imperial palace.

d2-p1331.name: Lama Temple
d2-p1331.blurb: Beijing's highest-specification Buddhist temple, originally a Qing prince's residence that later housed two emperors.

d2-p210981.name: Meridian Gate
d2-p210981.blurb: The grand southern entrance to the Forbidden City, featuring five gateways and nearly six hundred years of history.

d2-p1355.name: Summer Palace
d2-p1355.blurb: A beautifully preserved Qing royal garden built around Kunming Lake and Longevity Hill, inspired by Hangzhou's West Lake.

d3-train.name: Train G365
d3-train.blurb: High-speed train traveling from Beijing to Xi'an.

d3-hotel.name: TOWO Premium Hotel Xi'an Bell Tower
d3-hotel.blurb: Hotel located near the Bell Tower subway station in Xi'an.

d3-p8876.name: Xi'an City Wall
d3-p8876.blurb: China's largest and best-preserved ancient city wall, expanded during the Ming dynasty over earlier Sui-Tang foundations.

d3-p140628684.name: Daming Palace National Heritage Park
d3-p140628684.blurb: World Heritage site preserving the ruins of the Tang dynasty's most magnificent palace complex on Dragon Head Plateau.

d4-p8881.name: Small Wild Goose Pagoda
d4-p8881.blurb: A serene Tang dynasty multi-eaved brick pagoda known for its elegant silhouette and exquisite stone carvings.

static.text: From Seoul to Beijing and Xi'an, 5 days from Dec 3, 2 adults, we love history and food.
